incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 5777771111 - p99 tail latency spike detected for streaming API in eu-west-2. Alert threshold breached: p99 > 3s for 12min. Some streams reporting stalls / handshake timeouts. Paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Ack. Investigating. Adding people: @sre-lead, @eng-runtime, @cs-rep. Pls post quick topology + customer impact.

sre-lead: Thanks. First check: router + lb routes into EUW2. Can someone grab per-shard qps and queue depth? `metrics.query("router.tail_latency", region="euw2", p=99, window=15m)`

eng-runtime: Running quick queries, posting raw:
```
> router.requests.by_shard{region:euw2}.top(10)
shard=hot-42 qps=1200 queuesz=34 inflight=220
shard=hot-41 qps=1100 queuesz=8 inflight=95
shard=hot-13 qps=70 queuesz=1 inflight=3
```
It looks like a single shard (hot-42) is getting disproportionate traffic. Also seeing a spike in `route_mismatch` counter on LB: `lb.route_misroute{policy=weight-rollout} +1200 in last 10m`.

oncall-sre: That matches symptoms — tail caused by hot partition + misrouting. Any recent rollouts to routing policy?

ops-bot: DC deploy: `policy/weight-rollout` rollout started 5777769000 by @product-observe -> status: 82% -> target euw2 weights applied 10:1 (intentional).

product-observe: We started a staggered rollout to favor local routing in europe to reduce cross-region hops. Rollout config: `prefer_local: true, seed=2026-03-10-1940`. No known failures in canary.

eng-runtime: I see seed drift between control-plane and router table in euw2. Some hosts still have old seed -> hash partitioning inconsistency -> many keys remapped onto hot-42. Also a bug in weight calculation when `prefer_local` + hotkey smoothing disabled leads to sticky assignment.

oncall-sre: Can you confirm logs for misroute?

eng-runtime: Pasting relevant excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T12:02:41Z router[euw2-ep1]: WARN route_mismatch key=ctx-0f3a shard_expected=hot-11 shard_actual=hot-42 weight_delta=+0.86
2026-03-15T12:03:02Z router[euw2-ep3]: WARN connection_queue_len=256 shard=hot-42 token_wait_ms=4523
2026-03-15T12:05:10Z lb[euw2-lb2]: ERROR streaming_handshake timeout client=cs-789 status=504
```
This lines up with p99 spikes and streaming stalls.

cs-rep: Customer impact - we're seeing 6 active customers with streaming integrations in euw2. CS reported 3 support cases with reconnects and stalls; two customers flagged degraded UX and one observed occasional 500/504 during handshake.

sre-lead: Severity assessment: p95 ~0.9s but p99 > 4s for 18m in euw2 for streaming endpoints. Impacted % requests ~0.6% but targeted at high-volume keys. Recommend escalate to live bridge and immediate mitigations.

oncall-sre: Agreed. I'll open bridge and call for live mitigation. @miguel pls join for LB adjustments.

oncall-sre: Action plan (immediate):
- 1) Pause weight-rollout for `policy/weight-rollout` (control-plane) to stop additional drift. (`policy.pause rollout weight-rollout`)
- 2) Reconfigure router to prefer fallback balancing for troubled shards: set `hot_shard_fanout=4` for hot-42.
- 3) Drain hot-42 traffic to neighboring shards gradually (`router.reassign hot-42 -> hot-41, hot-43`) with max 10% steps.
- 4) Temporarily enable `kv-cache-prefix` for streaming handshake keys to reduce repeated work.

eng-runtime: I'll take 2 and 3. Running `routerctl reassign --shard hot-42 --targets hot-41,hot-43 --step 10` now. Expect ~2min per step. Logging progress.

ops-bot: Command accepted, job id=job-5777771111-01. Estimated completion ~18min.

eng-runtime: Step1 applied. queuesz on hot-42 dropped from 34 -> 20. p99 dropping from 4.8s -> 3.1s. continuing.

oncall-sre: Pausing rollout now.

ops-bot: `policy/weight-rollout` paused by oncall-sre at 5777771168.

eng-runtime: Step3 done. hot-42 queuesz=6 inflight=34. Observed p99 now 1.2s and falling. Streaming handshake 504s reduced.

miguel: Joining. I'll take a look at LB route table and bump misroute detector sensitivity to block bad mappings for 5m: `lbctl set misroute-protect --region euw2 --threshold 0.5 --duration 300s`.

ops-bot: `lbctl` change queued, applying across euw2 nodes.

miguel: Applied. We're seeing reduced misroute counts. Also adding temporary ejection for node euw2-ep5 which had high CPU and connection queues. Ejecting for 10m.

product-observe: Noting potential customer-visible change from ejection — will coordinate with CS.

cs-rep: Notifying affected customers with short blurb: "We're investigating streaming disruptions in eu-west-2 and applying mitigations. Some reconnects expected; we'll update in 30m."

sre-lead: Monitoring: cluster p99 back to baseline for most routes. Remaining tail is transient. Recommend keeping weight-rollout paused until seeds reconciled and smoothing bug fixed.

eng-runtime: Root cause summary for postmortem: staggered rollout + seed divergence + weight calculation bug in `prefer_local` path produced skewed hash mapping causing hot-42 to absorb remapped keys -> queue buildup -> streaming handshake timeouts.

oncall-sre: Current status: mitigations applied (reassign, lb ejection, misroute-protect), p99 reduced to ~1.1s, streaming handshake errors down 95%. Bridge closed for now but will keep monitoring for 1h.

miguel: Follow-ups assigned:
- eng-runtime: patch weight calc bug and add unit test for seed drift case (owner: @eng-runtime)
- infra: improve rollout guard to stop if misroute counter > X in 5m (owner: @product-observe + ops)
- oncall-sre: run reconciliation script to normalize seeds across euw2 control plane in next maintenance window (owner: @oncall-sre)
- cs-rep: customer follow-up updates and RC note (owner: @cs-rep)

eng-runtime: I'll open a PR with patch and add canary that validates mapping distribution. ETA 48h.

product-observe: Will add a precheck to rollout pipeline to block if `route_mismatch_rate` > 0.1% during rollout. ETA 24h.

cs-rep: Sent customer updates. No escalations to exec. One customer requested ETA; provided 4h window.

oncall-sre: Handoff: I'm handing this to @miguel for overnight monitoring at 5777771600 UTC. If p99 spikes above 2s again, unpause bridge and escalate to SRE lead.

oncall-sre: :thumbsup: closing active page.

miguel: Acknowledged. I'll keep dashboards up and will triage any regression. Adding a note to incident timeline.

product-observe: Filing postmortem ticket and linking to this thread.

eng-runtime: Logging final metrics snapshot: `p99_streaming_euw2=1.05s`, `misroute_rate=0.02%`, `hot-42.queuesz=3`.

cs-rep: Closing customer notifications thread in 30m if stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 5777771111 - status: mitigated. Next steps: postmortem assigned, follow-ups tracked.

miguel: Quick note for the postmortem: include the exact rollout window, seed checksums from control-plane and edge routers, and diff of hash assignments pre/post.

oncall-sre: Thanks team. If anything new pops up ping me.

sre-lead: Good run. Please keep the postmortem concise with clear remediation and owners. :white_check_mark:
